bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/link-pr62-15e86a1"
sha=15e86a1f7777ec537353d9284300cd5de61b6245
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
test -d "$root/node_modules" || exit 63
test -d "$root/artifacts/bot/node_modules" || exit 64
test ! -e "$stage/node_modules" || exit 65
test ! -e "$stage/artifacts/bot/node_modules" || exit 66
ln -s "$root/node_modules" "$stage/node_modules"
ln -s "$root/artifacts/bot/node_modules" "$stage/artifacts/bot/node_modules"
(cd "$stage/artifacts/bot" && pnpm run build:gaybbs) >/tmp/gace-link62-local-build-log 2>&1 || exit 67
node --check "$stage/artifacts/bot/dist/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 68
context="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link62-image.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$context"' EXIT
cp "$stage/artifacts/bot/dist/gaybbs.mjs" "$context/"
cat >"$context/Dockerfile" <<'DOCKERFILE'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
DOCKERFILE
docker build --pull=false --network=none --tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-candidate -f "$context/Dockerfile" "$context" >/tmp/gace-link62-fallback-log 2>&1 || exit 69
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-candidate >/dev/null
echo "CANDIDATE_FROM_EXISTING_IMAGE=PASS"
echo "PRODUCTION_UNMODIFIED=PASS"
